about: Rung 16: click/fill/scroll by role and accessible name, resolved without a model. The fixture is the accessibility tree of the built site with the assistant panel open (Chromium Accessibility.getFullAXTree, 73 nodes, captured 2026-11-24). Expectations are ground truth read off that tree, not off the resolver: a name with six identical buttons is a refusal, and a section the site never names in a heading is a refusal too.

tasks.note: the panel's SEND is aria-disabled until the input has text, so a click-only DSL must report it, not click it
